item.title: Benicia High boys basketball team holds off Berean Christian
item.description: WALNUT CREEK – In some ways, Friday’s game was a microcosm of Benicia High School’s entire boys basketball season. The Panthers showed flashes of brilliance and a balanced attack, but they also suffered from periods of inconsistency. item.title: Judge orders Fairfield assessment refunds
item.description: A Solano County Superior Court judge on Friday upheld a key appellate court ruling from last fall, finding that the City of Fairfield unlawfully increased property assessments without voter approval and must now halt the increases and provide a pathway for refunds. In the latest ruling, Judge Tim P. Kam noted that the City of Fairfield stipulated it had illegally assessed property owners.
